author: swivr
body:
Welcome to the new website! This post will contain information regarding the changes to the website.

Design / Layout:
  • Home page has latest news/updates taken straight from the discussions
  • Profile page updated
  • Added support page. This has a FAQ section, contact information and more.
Discussions:
  • "My Subscriptions" category only shows discussions that you have subscribed to in order of latest updated.
  • "My Discussions" category shows discussions that you have started.
  • "My Replies" shows discussions that you have replied to.
  • Create custom categories that group together multiple categories into one.
  • The number of unread replies in each discussion is displayed as well as the number of unread discussions which is displayed in the navigation bar beside each category.
  • New and reorganized categories
  • Number and list of online users shown on navigation bar
  • Preview tab when creating new discussions or replies allows for viewing a post before making it live.
  • Users are limited to one post every 30 seconds (if I remember correctly)
Profiles:
  • Stats tab: Detailed statistics in periods of the past 24 hours, week or all time
